sentences.text: Pankaj Kumar Kundu vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 25

Author: Samapti Chatterjee
Bench: Samapti Chatterjee
25.9.2017 Akd A.S.T. 337 of 2017 Pankaj Kumar Kundu
-vs-
The State of West Bengal & Ors.
Mr. Debasish Roy, Ms. Rituparna De Ghosh ... for the Petitioner

The petitioner has filed the criminal revisional application for quashing of the proceedings being G.R. No. 715 of 2017 pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ranaghat arising out of Taherpur Police Station Case No. 93 of 2017 dated 08.04.2017 under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code, Section 7(1)(a) (ii) of Essential Commodities Act, 1955, Sections 78/79, The Trade and Merchandise Mark Act, 1958,
Section 63 of the Copyright Act, 1957.
Mr. Roy, learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that during investigation send the samples of seized goods for its testing at West Bengal Public Health Laboratory, Govt. Of edible oil of various quality in bottling condition, pack in various used tin containers of various brand available in the market West Bengal, 2 No. Covent Rd., Kolkata - 700015 and collect report and in the report it is stated that ingredients of all seized goods are complies Food Safety and Standards Regulation- 2011.
It is found that sample of Palm Oil being Exhibit Mark "A" Complies FSS regulation w.r.t. parameters reported.
In support of his contention, Mr. Roy draws my attention to the page - 26 of the said criminal revisional application and also the opinion of the Food and Analyst.
Considering the above submission and after perusing the records, let this matter appear in the list on 10th November, 2017 before the Regular Bench under the heading "Motion".

There is a stay of operation of all further proceedings in G.R. No. 715 of 2017 arising out of Taherpur Police Station Case No. 93 of 2017 dated 08.04.2017 under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code,
Section 7(1)(a) (ii) of Essential Commodities Act, 1955, Sections 78/79, The Trade and Merchandise Mark Act, 1958, Section 63 of the Copyright Act, 1957 till 24th November, 2017.
The petitioner is directed to serve a copy of the application upon the learned Public Prosecutor and communicate the gist of the order and file an affidavit of service on the next date of hearing.
